decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's industrial waste-to-energy focus and has only a minor website mention, so it is at real risk of being cut, but it builds on an established nutrient offer and costs little to keep.
The modular plant extensions complement the firm's core waste-to-energy plants and support a multi-model product line, so they are likely to be kept.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship with its own page and sits in the firm's core direction, so it will very likely stay.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is presented as a strategic focus in a growing sustainability market, so the firm will likely keep developing it despite its only modest web presence.
